item.title: Ocean Park ride remains suspended 2 days after 15 trapped mid-air for 20 minutes
item.description: An Ocean Park ride has remained suspended – two days after a malfunction left people stranded mid-air for 20 minutes. The incident happened just before 3pm on Saturday, when the Wild Twister ride stopped working due to a signalling error, according to a statement from Ocean Park. item.title: Hong Kong prosecutors drop charges against surgeon with dementia in Botox death case
item.description: Hong Kong prosecutors have dropped 21 charges against a nonagenarian plastic surgeon after a court granted him an unconditional release for the unlawful killing of a patient due to his advanced dementia. item.title: South Korea’s Lee snaps selfie with China’s Xi using gifted ‘backdoor’ phone
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung snapped a selfie with Xi Jinping using a smartphone gifted to him by the Chinese leader, who had joked at their last meeting that the device might be capable of spying. item.title: Up to 11-hour waits at Hong Kong public hospitals at night despite fee hike
item.description: Accident and emergency (A&E) departments at Hong Kong public hospitals have seen long queues at night despite a fee increase taking effect last week, with non-urgent patients waiting up to 11 hours. item.title: Cold weather to persist until Friday, Hong Kong Observatory says
item.description: Cold weather in Hong Kong will continue until Friday under the influence of the winter monsoon, according to the Observatory. The mercury dipped to 12 degrees Celsius in urban areas on Tuesday morning, according to the Hong Kong Observatory (HKO). The cold weather warning is currently in force. item.title: China-sanctioned Japanese lawmaker says Taiwan ‘independent country’
item.description: A China-born Japanese lawmaker sanctioned by Beijing arrived in Taipei on Tuesday, vowing to tell the world that “Taiwan is an independent country”. Hei Seki, a member of Japan’s parliament, was sanctioned in September by China and banned from entering the country for “spreading fallacies” on issues such as Taiwan, Hong Kong and disputed islands. item.description: The Hong Kong government has announced the cancellation of the technology minister’s scheduled business trip to the United States without explanation.
